items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. An' we'd made all kinds of records all over the country.

ctx.x: Who was that? Was that Nesuhi Ertegun?*

Yeah. An' we'd made all kinds of records all over the country. Sometime he come to my house in Chicago an' write... sit down an' write...take my ol' number an' write some other stuff with it an' change the whole thing around.
But anyway, he was travellin' around. So then we got into the business of rock 'n' roll. Were the first record ever was put out in rock 'n' roll, I did it.
